exposure: Extent of ulcerative colitis (pancolitis vs. limited to splenic flexure)
cohort: 43 females with ulcerative colitis and coexisting pregnancy over a 4-year period from January 2010 to December 2013.
finding: Women with pancolitis had a significantly higher rate of spontaneous abortions, preterm delivery, low birth weight, and disease relapse compared to those with ulcerative colitis limited to the splenic flexure.
